note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent judge) after the row's annotation moved from {not-applicable} to {gap}. RFC 7432 Section 11.2 reads: "If the PE has already advertised Inclusive Multicast Ethernet Tag routes for two or more EVIs that it now desires to aggregate, then the PE MUST re-advertise those routes.  The re-advertised routes MUST be the same as the original ones, except for the PMSI Tunnel attribute and the label carried in that attribute." Aggregation is a MAY of a PE using a P-multicast tree, but Ze fills the PE role on the control plane and no owner decision declines that feature, so the absent procedure is a conformance gap, and the earlier not-applicable verdict no longer stands. Ze has none of it: internal/component/bgp/plugins/nlri/evpn/config.go::parseConfigRoute and encode.go::l2vpnRouteToEVPNParams build only the Inclusive Multicast Ethernet Tag route an operator supplies, attaching extended communities and no PMSI Tunnel attribute; internal/component/bgp/message/update_build_evpn.go::ValidateEVPNOriginationMode checks only a route target for a type 3 route. internal/core/bgp/attribute/wire.go lists PMSI among known codes without a parser, and the only PMSI code in the tree is the name-only registration in internal/component/bgp/plugins/nlri/mvpn/register.go. No code models an EVI, binds EVIs to a P-multicast tree, or re-advertises routes on aggregation.
